name: bat_social
character: Bat social calls heard in a roost: short, high, downward chirps in small groups, from several animals, with gaps between.
sources: ESTIMATE: f0 8.5-13.5 kHz, lengths and bout rate are written from "audible below 20 kHz" and "squeaks, squawks and chittering"; no recording was analysed and no duration in ms was found
